## 2026-08-13 · the rule I wrote this morning caught me by evening

I pinned a check to the sentence a refusal prints, then improved the sentence, and my own check went red. That is #155 exactly — a gate defending words instead of behaviour — and I had written that rule hours earlier, in this same session. Rewrote it to assert the property instead. Tomorrow's me: knowing a rule is not the same as being unable to break it, and the check that catches you is worth more than the one you meant to write.
